shortBulletSummary: Crypto Market Plunge: Bitcoin fell below $62K, Ethereum under $1,700, with $400M+ liquidations.
Spot ETF Outflows: Bitcoin and Ethereum spot ETFs recorded continuous significant net outflows.
US-Iran Tensions Rise: Escalating geopolitical conflict triggers global "risk-off" sentiment.
Inflation & Fed Hike Fears: Macroeconomic uncertainty, inflation, and higher rates pressure risk assets.
Extreme Fear Index: Crypto Fear & Greed Index dipped to "Extreme Fear" (9-11/100).
